answer: Primary ordinal regression (proportional odds, statsmodels OrderedModel): each additional ongoing medical condition (MHONGO='Yes' count) is associated with OR = 1.247, i.e. approximately a +25% increase in the odds of higher COVID-19 severity per additional ongoing condition (95% CI −7.6% to +68.3%, p = 0.15), controlling for BCG vaccination status (TRTGRP) and patient-interaction variables (patients_seen, expect_interact). Answer: ≈25% increase in odds per additional ongoing condition. Not statistically significant in the primary complete-case cohort (n=151 subjects with COVID-19 AE and recorded AESEV); the pre-declared sensitivity including all 1000 subjects (no-COVID-AE assigned lowest category) yields +31.7% (OR 1.32, p=0.0015). Severity was operationalized as the maximum AESEV (1–4) among a subject's COVID-19 adverse events because no direct COVID-19 severity variable exists in the inputs.
